machine: development machine, Windows x64 (the app ran in CPU fallback mode)
setup: tools/offline_check.py serve: a Python audit hook logs every network attempt of the app server process and refuses any that is not loopback. Headless Edge with a net log (--log-net-log), every non-loopback host made unreachable (--host-resolver-rules "MAP * ~NOTFOUND, EXCLUDE 127.0.0.1", --proxy-server=http://127.0.0.1:9). One replay session (--replay of an eval recording), then the report page and the history page, driven over the DevTools protocol.
summary_command: python tools/offline_check.py summarize <python log> --net-log <edge net log>
note: URLs are reduced to host names here, because the browser's own request URLs carry client identifiers. The app pages made no request off loopback. The non-loopback URLs were started by Edge itself for its own services, and none was answered.
